svg.title: Equation 10.4-6
svg.desc: LaTeX source: \begin{matrix} \mathbf{f}(\mathbf{x}): \end{matrix}\left\{ \begin{aligned} & {\dot{\varphi}}_{E} = \omega_{U}\varphi_{N} - \omega_{N}\sin\varphi_{U} \\ & {\dot{\varphi}}_{N} = - \omega_{U}\varphi_{E} + \omega_{N}(1 - \cos\varphi_{U}) \\ & {\dot{\varphi}}_{U} = \omega_{N}\varphi_{E}\cos\varphi_{U} \\ & \delta{\dot{v}}_{E}^{n} = f_{sf,E}^{n}(1 - \cos\varphi_{U}) + f_{sf,N}^{n}\sin\varphi_{U} - f_{sf,U}^{n}(\varphi_{N}\cos\varphi_{U} + \varphi_{E}\sin\varphi_{U}) \\ & \delta{\dot{v}}_{N}^{n} = - f_{sf,E}^{n}\sin\varphi_{U} + f_{sf,N}^{n}(1 - \cos\varphi_{U}) - f_{sf,U}^{n}(\varphi_{N}\sin\varphi_{U} - \varphi_{E}\cos\varphi_{U}) \end{aligned} \right.\qquad(10.4-6)
